'''Baylagon Technical Institute''' was an education institution where students learned various aspects of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] systems. [[Celia Durasha]] spent a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] at the Institute, excelling in [[Gender/Legends|her]] studies. After her graduation, Durasha was hired by [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]].<ref name="Certain Point of View">{{JournalCite|8|A Certain Point of View (short story)}}</ref>
